Working closely with senior operational leadership, you will play a pivotal role in shaping business performance, optimising manufacturing costs and supporting strategic investments and operational transformation. The position offers significant international exposure, executive-level interaction and the opportunity to influence financial and operational decisions across multiple manufacturing locations. Key Responsibilities Lead Operations Finance activities across multiple manufacturing sites, ensuring financial discipline, performance visibility and alignment with business objectives. Act as a strategic Finance Business Partner to senior Operations Leadership, influencing business decisions and driving sustainable profitability. Lead, develop and mentor an international finance team, fostering accountability, collaboration and high performance. Oversee budgeting, forecasting, financial planning and operational performance reporting across the manufacturing network. Consolidate and analyse financial results, translating complex data into actionable recommendations for senior leadership. Drive manufacturing cost optimisation, productivity improvements, inventory performance and working capital efficiency. Provide financial leadership for strategic initiatives, including manufacturing footprint optimisation, production transfers, capacity expansion and operational transformation. Evaluate capital investments, automation projects and business cases, ensuring financial viability and alignment with strategic priorities. Establish and monitor operational and financial KPIs, identifying performance gaps, risks and improvement opportunities. Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Engineering and Corporate Finance to improve operational effectiveness and financial outcomes. Ensure robust financial controls, compliance with accounting standards and effective audit processes. Champion continuous improvement, reporting automation and data-driven decision-making across finance operations. Your Profile Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics or a related discipline. At least 10 years of progressive experience in Finance, Controlling or Financial Management within industrial or manufacturing environments. Significant experience in Operations Finance, Manufacturing Finance, Plant Controlling or Regional Finance leadership. Proven track record supporting multiple manufacturing sites within an international or multinational organisation. Demonstrated experience leading, developing and managing geographically dispersed finance teams. Strong expertise in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, standard costing and operational performance management. Solid understanding of manufacturing cost structures, inventory management, capital expenditure and operational financial processes. Proven ability to influence senior executives and build trusted partnerships with operational leadership. Experience supporting strategic investments, manufacturing transformation and cost optimisation programmes. Strong analytical capabilities, commercial judgement and strategic decision-making skills. Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management abilities. Knowledge of IFRS or US GAAP and strong financial governance principles. Advanced Excel and ERP experience, ideally SAP. Professional accounting qualifications such as ACCA, CIMA, ACA or CPA would be advantageous. Experience with business intelligence tools, financial analytics and continuous improvement methodologies is valued. Fluent English and willingness to travel internationally as required. What Sets You Apart You are more than a finance leader. You are a strategic business partner who understands how financial performance, manufacturing operations and business strategy connect. You combine financial expertise with operational insight, challenge assumptions and influence decisions that deliver measurable business value. You are comfortable navigating complex international environments, leading geographically dispersed teams and engaging with senior stakeholders across different functions and cultures. Above all, you bring commercial acumen, leadership credibility, strong ownership and the ability to turn financial insights into meaningful operational improvements. Why Consider This Opportunity? Take on a strategic finance leadership role with international scope and significant business impact. Influence financial strategy and operational performance across a global manufacturing network. Partner directly with senior leadership on business-critical decisions and transformation initiatives. Lead and develop an international finance team. Contribute to major investment decisions, manufacturing optimisation and long-term business growth. Benefit from geographical flexibility within the EMEA region and exposure to a dynamic international business environment. Interested in Exploring This Opportunity? If you are an experienced Operations Finance leader with a strong manufacturing background and the ambition to influence business performance on an international scale, we would welcome a confidential conversation. All applications and discussions will be handled with strict confidentiality. Strong working knowledge of welding inspection procedures, WPS, PQR, welder qualification requirements, and welding acceptance criteria. Ability to interpret engineering drawings, welding symbols, inspection specifications, and applicable codes. Experience preparing, reviewing, and maintaining welding inspection and NDT documentation. review_candidates.description: Product Manager - Enterprise Software MCS Group is partnering with an established B2B enterprise software company as they look to appoint an experienced Product Manager to join their growing product function. This is an opportunity for a commercially minded Product Manager who enjoys being close to engineering, taking ownership of delivery and turning complex customer requirements into working software. We're not looking for someone who simply manages a backlog or moves tickets through Jira. We're looking to connect with Product Managers who enjoy making decisions, challenging assumptions, working closely with technical teams and taking real ownership of getting products and features delivered. This role will suit someone who enjoys the practical side of product management. Someone who understands the bigger picture but is equally comfortable getting into the detail with engineers, solving delivery challenges and ensuring commitments are met. Pretty much remote/working from home - within Northern Ireland - with 1-2 days per month expectation to be in office. The Role The Product Manager will own product delivery from initial requirements through to release, ensuring teams are clear on priorities, scope and expectations. Work closely with engineering teams to develop accurate estimates, challenge assumptions and establish realistic delivery commitments. Balance customer requirements, commercial priorities and technical considerations to make informed product decisions. Take ownership of the product backlog and roadmap, ensuring priorities translate into measurable progress. Work alongside senior product leadership to support the evolution of an established enterprise software platform. Drive accountability across teams, proactively identifying blockers and keeping delivery on track. Engage with internal stakeholders and customers to understand requirements and translate these into clear, actionable plans. What We're Looking For Proven experience as a Product Manager within a B2B software or enterprise SaaS environment. A strong track record of software delivery, with the ability to work effectively alongside engineering teams. Experience managing complex products, competing priorities and stakeholder expectations. Commercial awareness and the confidence to make decisions and challenge stakeholders when needed. A good understanding of software development processes, estimation and agile delivery methodologies. Someone pragmatic, organised and comfortable taking ownership rather than simply coordinating activity. Strong communication skills and the ability to bridge the gap between technical teams and commercial stakeholders. Salary Up to £75,000 plus benefits. Even if this position is not right for you, we may have others that are. Please visit MCS Group to view a wide selection of our current and exclusive roles www.mcsgroup.jobs All conversations will be treated in the strictest of confidence.
